newsitem.title: USA: Brown & Williamson to appeal Carter verdict in Fla.
newsitem.headline: Brown & Williamson to appeal Carter verdict in Fla.

text.p: Brown & Williamson, a unit of B.A.T. Industries Plc, on Thursday said it was appealing the verdict in a Florida trial in which a former smoker with lung cancer claimed that cigarettes caused his illness.
The jury ruled that Brown & Williamson's American Tobacco unit misled Grady Carter of Jacksonville about the dangers of smoking. The verdict was handed down on August 9.
The company said the verdict was an "aberration" because the court "allowed the jury to hear inadmissible evidence and evidence based on speculation."
It said it would file a written appeal in mid-February and that oral arguments would follow.
